items.exampleEn: The child read the long story aloud with surprising fluency.
items.exampleZh: 那孩子朗讀那篇長故事時流暢得令人驚訝。

items.exampleEn: Teenagers invent new slang every year, and adults struggle to keep up.
items.exampleZh: 青少年每年都發明新俚語，大人很難跟上。

items.exampleEn: Water got inside the phone and damaged its circuitry.
items.exampleZh: 水跑進手機裡，損壞了它的電路。

items.exampleEn: A group of schoolgirls in blue uniforms waited at the bus stop.
items.exampleZh: 一群穿著藍色制服的女學生在公車站等車。

items.exampleEn: Choosing the right synonym can make your writing more interesting.
items.exampleZh: 選對同義字能讓你的文章更有趣。
items.glossZh: 同義字；（比喻）代表、代名詞

items.exampleEn: An alphabetical index at the back of the book helps you find topics quickly.
items.exampleZh: 書末按字母排序的索引能幫你快速找到主題。

items.exampleEn: Modern microscopy lets scientists see the tiny parts inside a cell.
items.exampleZh: 現代顯微技術讓科學家能看到細胞內的微小構造。

items.sentenceEn: Reading every day is the best way to improve your fluency.
items.sentenceZh: 每天閱讀是提升流利度的最好方法。

items.audioEn: The names on the list are in alphabetical order, so you'll find yours near the end.
items.audioZh: 名單上的名字是按字母順序排列，所以你的名字會在後面。
items.questionZh: 說話者說對方的名字在名單的哪裡？

items.sentenceEn: Happy and glad are synonyms, but they are not used in exactly the same way.
items.sentenceZh: happy 和 glad 是同義字，但用法不完全一樣。

items.sentenceEn: My grandmother still remembers the songs she sang as a schoolgirl.
items.sentenceZh: 我奶奶還記得她當女學生時唱的歌。

items.stemEn: Avoid using ____ in a formal essay; choose standard words instead.
items.stemZh: 正式文章裡避免使用俚語，請改用標準用字。

items.stemEn: The engineer opened the radio to check its ____ for a broken wire.
items.stemZh: 工程師打開收音機，檢查電路裡有沒有斷掉的電線。

items.passageEn: When my grandmother was a schoolgirl, she dreamed of being a scientist. She loved microscopy and spent hours looking at insect wings and leaves. Today she teaches science at a community center, and her students are often surprised by her fluency in three languages. She keeps her books in alphabetical order and has a notebook full of interesting words, including slang from different decades and lists of synonyms. Last month, she fixed the circuitry of an old radio for fun, and it played music again. She says learning is like a marathon, not a sprint. For our family, her name is a synonym for curiosity.
items.passageZh: 我奶奶還是女學生時，夢想成為科學家。她熱愛顯微鏡觀察，常花好幾個小時看昆蟲翅膀和樹葉。如今她在活動中心教自然科學，她能流利地說三種語言，常讓學生驚訝。她把書按字母順序排好，還有一本記滿有趣字詞的筆記本，包括不同年代的俚語和一串串同義字。上個月，她為了好玩修好一部舊收音機的電路，它又能播音樂了。她說學習像馬拉松，不是短跑。對我們家來說，她的名字就是好奇心的代名詞。

questions.questionZh: 學生常對奶奶的什麼感到驚訝？
options: 收藏了很多的舊收音機

items.promptZh: 這部電影裡有很多年輕人的俚語。
referenceEn: This movie has a lot of young people's slang.
There is a lot of slang used by young people in this film.
rubricZh: slang 是不可數名詞（例如 a lot of slang）
句型可寫，例如 This movie has…、There is… in this film 等

items.instructionZh: 用 fluency 造一個句子，說說你怎麼提升某種語言或技能的流利度。
referenceEn: I watch foreign shows every night to build my fluency.
My fluency improved a lot after I lived abroad for a year.
rubricZh: 時態合理即可（例如 watch、improved）
